text: Supports request variables for reusing values within a request
quote: Request variables.

text: Revamped OAuth 2.0 support with multiple grant types
quote: OAuth 2.0 revamp, plus support for multiple Grant Types.

text: OIDC-based single sign-on for login
quote: OIDC-based SSO.

text: Headers/auth set on a collection apply automatically to all requests inside it
quote: When you add a header or auth to a collection, it will be applied to all requests in that collection.

text: Can embed a mini interactive version of Hoppscotch into an HTML page
quote: Embed: Create a mini-version of Hoppscotch that you can embed in an HTML page, allowing your audience to interact with your API request.

text: Server configuration can be managed from a self-host admin dashboard
quote: You can manage your server configurations directly from the self-host admin dashboard.

text: Environments support secret variables to keep sensitive values hidden
quote: Secret variables in environments.

text: Official CLI runs API tests, automates monitoring, and manages collections from the terminal
quote: Use the Hoppscotch CLI to run API tests, automate monitoring, and manage collections from your terminal.

text: CLI test runner can output a JUnit report for collection runs
quote: The hopp test command now has the ability to generate a JUnit Report for collection runs in the CLI.

text: Ships an official MCP server exposing collections, requests, environments and teams to an agent
quote: Hoppscotch ships an MCP server of its own. It hands the host your collections, requests, environments, and teams, so an agent can read and change them for you.

text: MCP server can send real HTTP requests on behalf of a connected agent
quote: It hands the host your collections, requests, environments, and teams, so an agent can read and change them for you. It also sends real HTTP requests

text: Community Edition is free, open-source and MIT licensed
quote: Hoppscotch Community Edition is free and open-source. It is licensed under the MIT License.

text: Enterprise Edition adds SAML SSO, on-prem deployment and audit logs
quote: SAML-based SSO, on-prem deployment, audit logs, and more. Hoppscotch Enterprise Edition is a self-hosted version of Hoppscotch Cloud with enterprise-ready features

text: Can self-host the product on your own infrastructure with full data ownership
quote: Self-host Hoppscotch on your own infrastructure with full data ownership.

text: Can import requests from a cURL command
quote: Import cURL

text: Generates/copies request code snippets for 10+ languages and frameworks
quote: Generate/copy request code snippets for 10+ languages and frameworks

text: Supports WebSocket full-duplex connections
quote: Establish full-duplex communication channels over a single TCP connection.

text: Supports pre-request scripting executed before a request is sent
quote: Snippets of code associated with a request that is executed before the request is sent.

text: Lets teams collaborate to design, develop and test APIs together
quote: Helps you collaborate across your teams to design, develop, and test APIs faster.

text: Can use OpenAPI tags as folders when importing a spec
quote: Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI.

text: Supports GraphQL query execution
quote: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries with your existing data.

text: Organizes requests into collections and folders that can be reused with one click
quote: Keep your API requests organized with collections and folders. Reuse them with a single click.

text: AI features can rename requests, generate payloads, and write pre-request scripts and tests automatically
quote: Use AI-powered features in Hoppscotch to rename requests, generate payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically.

text: Desktop app bypasses browser CORS restrictions for requests
quote: Use the Hoppscotch Desktop App which is not subject to CORS restrictions.

text: Can add and manage PEM/PFX client certificates for SSL/TLS authentication
quote: Add and manage PEM or PFX client certificates for SSL/TLS authentication in the Hoppscotch Desktop App or via the Hoppscotch Agent.

text: Admin dashboard offers enhanced user management
quote: Enhanced user management in admin dashboard.

text: Cross-platform desktop app for creating and managing API requests
quote: Hoppscotch Desktop App is a cross-platform desktop application that helps you create and manage API requests.

text: Supports simultaneous import of collections and environments together
quote: Support simultaneous imports of collections and environments.

text: Bulk edit feature to add/modify multiple request parameters at once
quote: Hoppscotch also offers a Bulk edit feature, allowing you to add or modify multiple request parameters at once, with each key-value pair on a new line separated by a colon (:).

text: Team search available in workspace search and spotlight
quote: Team search in workspace search and spotlight.
